## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (e.g. new statutory adapter, policy rule)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Testing enhancement

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] All 82 automated tests pass (`bun run test`)
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passes with zero errors (`bun run lint`)
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`bun run build`)
- [ ] No hardcoded API keys, credentials, or local system paths
- [ ] Cryptographic audit ledger remains valid (`GET /api/audit-logs/verify`)
- [ ] No unauthorized AI provider fingerprints or promotional badges
